ratings_why.fun: One shared death count feeds a dozen cards, and cueing your own deaths with Berus, the Villain and Zaltys gives a real puzzle every Start of Combat; I'd happily draft it.
ratings_why.distinct: Self-cued fake deaths and Shed Skins for other tribes are fresh, but Play Dead and Old Crest sit close to Reborn and Rivendare-style deathrattle doubling.

verdict_why: The core is ready; one real wording gap (buffs on Anguis's shared-stat Tails) is worth a quick pass.

points.text: Tails share stats stored on Anguis, so it's unclear what happens when the Wreath-Layer, Zaltys or a Shed Skin buffs one Tail: does every Tail grow, or only that one? Say which.
The Red Barn Villain's murder of 'the friendly unit with the least Health' could pick himself; say 'other friendly unit' or confirm self-murder is meant.
Old Crest doubling Natrix's scripted deaths is the best line in the tribe; one rules line that a doubled death repeats that death's effect but doesn't advance her order would save players a guess.
The Natterjack only reads the count; letting it pay more when a non-Trouper played dead would reward the Shed Skin costume-rack line too.
The Matron's Hatchlings are pure fodder; a small hook (a Hatchling that plays dead the turn it's laid feeds Ardea's count) would tie her into the rave instead of only the pan.

standouts.why: Zaltys turns your own Berus, Villain and splash into free deaths, and reaches other tribes too: the hinge of the whole cascade.
Dame Natrix's three scripted deaths make order and timing a real decision, and Broken Heart lights up every watcher at once.
The Barnstormer plays dead without dying, so he is fuel for Wreath-Layer, Blood-and-Thunder, Ardea and the Natterjack all at once.

weakest.why: The Natterjack is a plain counter-reader with no decision attached.
Footlights Keeper is a flat front-row upgrade with no interaction beyond Fairy Rings.
The Compost Heap Matron is a triple engine that touches the death count only indirectly.

flags.note: Blood-and-Thunder with golden Natrix's double Broken Heart and Old Crest is a near-quadratic splash held only by the per-throw cap.
Wreath-Layer plus Broken Heart and the Barnstormer hits its four-a-fight cap easily; two copies give eight permanent buffs a fight.
Buffs to a Tail whose stats live on Anguis are undefined.
